title: Field, path and version naming drift
description: Grouped naming drift in SPEC: TextBody content/mimeType (l.1357) vs format:markdown (l.1431) vs MIME (l.1601); senderDid/senderDID; channelCid/channelCID; /peer/v1/health (l.799) vs /v1/agora/peer/health; DNS-SD _agora._tcp (l.876) vs _agora-relay._udp/_tcp (l.783); ClientHello agora/0.1 (l.1919) in a v0.2 spec. Fix: pick one spelling per name and normalize. Line numbers refer to import/ files (notes/research-2026-10-16.md).
